chooseDay: Jump to a day or date

noPanels: Add a panel to build your workspace.
transitUnavailable: Transit routes and travel times are not connected yet.
riskEmpty: No verified risk data for this day.
researchNote: Illustrative research, not a live search.

chatEmpty: Start a discussion with your group.
aiIntro: Ask about this trip. Tripify reads your itinerary, members and budget before answering. AI proposes — your group decides.

aiSignIn: Sign in to use Tripify AI.
